name: Paperclip Notebook
description: Publish, find, and share reports, files, and interactive pages with your Paperclip Cloud account.

methods.whenToUse: Sign in with Paperclip Cloud and let your assigned agents publish and manage your Notebook pages.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect your Paperclip Cloud account. Assigned agents can read available pages, publish and update your pages, change sharing including making pages public, manage versions, and delete or restore your pages. Manage individual actions in Permissions.
